base_pose: standing upright on two legs, wings folded

walk.action: hopping and strutting forward on two legs
walk.suffix: , small quick bird steps, head bobbing with each hop, wings tucked, in place, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: legs mid-stride with one extended forward and one pushing back, wings folded at sides, torso angled slightly forward, neck stretched upright

idle.suffix: , gentle breathing, feathers settling, occasional head turn, no walking, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: perched upright on two legs, head slightly tilted, wings folded at sides, tail feathers angled downward

run.suffix: , rapid little bird steps, body leaning forward, wings half-raised, in place, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: running fast on two legs, leaning forward, wings tucked

sleep.action: roosting asleep with its head tucked into its feathers, breathing slowly
sleep.suffix: , chest feathers rising and falling with each slow breath, plumage ruffling faintly with the rhythm, eyes staying closed throughout, calm looping roost animation, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: eyes closed, head lowered and resting on its chest, feathers puffed up, sleeping

sit.suffix: , nestled down with small head movements and gentle breathing, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: settled low on its perch, feathers fluffed, resting

eat.suffix: , quick repeating head dips to peck then up, small pecking motion, no walking, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: head down, pecking at seed on the ground, beak open

jump.action: flapping up in a startled hop
jump.suffix: , wings flaring out in a quick upward flutter then settling, one reaction flutter, no camera movement, no panning

play.suffix: , lively wing flicks and head bobs, cheerful reaction loop, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings fluttering, hopping playfully, head bobbing

fly.suffix: , wings beating up and down in a smooth flight cycle, hovering in place, no horizontal movement of the body, no camera movement, no panning

control.pose: wings spread wide open, mid-flight, flying
